title: Owner Responsibility Date for Shared Storage (Repair Estimates & Appointments Insurer Bulletin)
content:
**Bulletin.** For storage shared on a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking, the owner's responsibility date follows how the owner decided:

1. When the decline request was confirmed more than **2** calendar days after it was requested, the owner had decided at the request, so the responsibility date is the date the request was made.
2. When no decline request is confirmed and more than the estimate type's validity days have passed since the estimate written date, the responsibility date is the last valid day of the estimate, the estimate written date plus the validity days.
3. In any other case this bulletin does not move the responsibility date.

**Validity days by estimate type**

| Estimate type | Validity days |
|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 30 |
| Drive-In Estimate | 30 |
| Scheduled Estimate | 30 |
| Mobile Estimate | 30 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 45 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 45 |

**Cases** (hypothetical bookings)

| Decline request | Days since the estimate written date | Responsibility date |
|---|---|---|
| Requested 2 June, confirmed 6 June (4 days) | — | 2 June, the request date |
| Requested 2 June, confirmed 5 June (3 days) | — | 2 June, the request date |
| Requested 2 June, confirmed 4 June (2 days — not more than 2) | — | not moved by this bulletin |
| None confirmed; Blueprint Teardown Estimate written 1 May | 50 days | 15 June, the 45th day after 1 May |
| None confirmed; Blueprint Teardown Estimate written 1 May | 45 days exactly | not moved by this bulletin |

The days since the estimate written date are counted to the day the owner's payment is worked out.
